description: workflow admission inside authorize(): each case threads its steps through ONE replay store

cases.name: pay-after-quote
cases.description: quote, then pay with the quote receipt: both allowed.

cases.name: pay-before-quote-escalates-and-keeps-the-counter
cases.description: pay with no quote receipt escalates (an unpromised dependency); the SAME PCActn is allowed once the receipt exists (the counter was not spent).

cases.name: amount-over-the-quote
cases.description: refunding 31 against a quoted 30 is refused by the edge relation.

cases.name: step-not-in-the-workflow
cases.description: a payment wire the principal never committed is refused although the plan root is the committed one.

cases.name: step-with-other-verb
cases.description: the operation differs from the committed verb for that step.

cases.name: plan-root-not-the-committed-one
cases.description: the PCActn plan root is not the one the workflow commits.

cases.name: tampered-commitment
cases.description: the commitment body was edited after signing.

cases.name: commitment-signed-under-another-domain
cases.description: a signature over the same body under another domain does not verify.

cases.name: expired-commitment
cases.description: the commitment is past its expiry.

cases.name: receipt-from-an-unpinned-key
cases.description: a quote receipt signed by a key the server did not pin.

cases.name: secret-label-reaches-a-guarded-step
cases.description: a secret label produced by pay may not reach notify.

cases.name: workflow-required-but-absent
cases.description: with `required` set, a call that carries no workflow step is refused.

expect.reason: workflow: this call carries no workflow step (fail closed)

cases.name: workflow-optional-and-absent
cases.description: without `required`, a standalone action proceeds as before.

cases.name: replay-after-an-allowed-step
cases.description: an allowed PCActn cannot be presented again: the workflow admits it, the replay counter refuses it.

cases.name: undecodable-pcactn-with-a-workflow
cases.description: a PCActn that cannot be decoded is refused as a wire error even when it carries a workflow step.

cases.name: undecodable-pcactn-without-a-workflow
cases.description: the same undecodable PCActn with no workflow and none required: the same wire refusal.

cases.name: undecodable-pcactn-workflow-required-and-absent
cases.description: with `required` set and no workflow step, the workflow refusal comes first (it needs no PCActn).

expect.reason: workflow: this call carries no workflow step (fail closed)
